notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #75 "What's on the courier menu...?"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]Break is over - we're back with further changes for our game! This time we look at game menu![/h2]

Main menu is the first thing you will look at when starting the game so it's no wonder that we're treating it with utmost respect! We want to convey several things to you by just looking at it - we want to make you feel at home and what could transmit that feeling better than the image of our beloved truck? It definitely is much homely and better looking then a simple one-coloured menu! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/da0a2b1054f560ab8c15919523283a2c831633ed.png[/img]

A little nice touch, in our humble opinion, is an icon of a package serving as an on/off button. Those little features make menu navigation so much more enjoyable and even though it's a simple notion it still can create fantastic and pleasant experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/26bcc44f691c48d21019cc58e8915334c82d68f8.png[/img]

Please however do keep in mind that this particular menu is still a work-in-progress prototype. We are sure to make additions and change the menu probably many times as we move on with the development. 

However we publish it in order to ask for your opinion - [b]how do you like this kind of menu[/b]? Do you have your own preferences? Perhaps you want to let us know about the possible direction we might take? We're very open for suggestions and we'd love to hear back from you! 

[i]Please leave us a comment with your opinion about our menu - we can't wait to know your thoughts![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #74 "Now for a breather..."
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]With so many changes happening during last few weeks we feel that our courier deserves a little break...[/h2]

Have you ever wondered what is our courier doing after his shift is over? Or... whether he ever ends his shift? Perhaps he is constantly at work, always making sure that the deliveries are going smoothly and without a hitch? While we believe that he would be more than capable of doing so we still think that he needs to catch a breather from time to time. Just... destress, refuel his energy tanks and then come back at it with triple the usual power!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/81698f1185d59b6e114f74d329689147aec29d84.png[/img]

The truck neatly parked next to the door signifies that he is finally getting his well-deserved rest. Perhaps after a short nap he will then go to the park for a short stroll or to a nearby cafe to grab himself some coffee? On his free time he is after all allowed to do anything he wants! What do you think our courier is doing after his job? As we do our best to enhance the game graphically we believe that he will have many different areas to visit and recuperate! And what is more - in future you can expect more place to visit and explore! 

After all as we said previously - the city always changes! 

[i]Let us know about your ideas for the way our courier can rest - he might use some of them![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #73 "Further UI Changes!"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]So many changes that we've been showcasing lately... and we're not stopping![/h2]

We've taken care of our courier's image, we've provided him with a new truck and we've even been diligent enough to prepare new boxes and packages for our customers. Everything for the sake of great deliveries and doing awesome job. However - that's not enough! We strive to make even more great adjustments and improvements and this time we're thinking... about you!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/693342e1939ca48ae56811dac147aa6412b12b4b.png[/img]

UI changes, afterall, are addressed to you! We want you to feel as comfortable when playing the game and enjoy the adventures of your courier to the fullest. A clean, nice looking UI is the way to go and we strongly believe that similar to package being important for the customer and truck for our driver - the new UI elements will be working in favour of your enjoyment! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/40a244b38cd47cfb5ef219098feeb17cbc33fdff.png[/img]

Minimap, speedometer and even watch - all of them will be valuable tools letting you know more and perform your job on the highest level. As the dark blue is the colour that is inherently linked and combined with our company we decided to use it for the new UI elements and we believe that they look quite nice! What do you think? Be sure to let us know about your thoughts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/5959f858911b245f4c50304e0587f48e7e1929a0.png[/img]

[i]Let us know about your opinion in the comments![/i]

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #72 "New package has arrived!"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]Did you know that over $150 billion is spent almost every year on producing packages around the globe? It's a beaming market and it's connected to our topic today![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/4b1533ede3acfc47681bfe17b14db5d7608258da.png[/img]

As you can see we have just received new packages with the logo of our company visible on it! They seem to be sturdier, better looking and posses the necessary warnings and information - it's a top notch quality! As we strive to be the best delivery company we need to make sure that even on the level of boxes and wrappings we are the best around. After all our customers will appreciate the fact that we've delivered their goodies in a well-protected environment - safe truck, steady courier hands and reliable packages. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/f8175653c70be286849cd52e252b453a2ff14fe3.png[/img]

Here, take a closer look - the box is safely secured by the use of gray scotch tape, making sure that nothing will fall out from it. Additionally you can see a clear indication regarding how the package should be placed on the ground and where is the top/bottom. Address card added to the packaging completes the image. 

[i]What do you think about our new packages? Do you like? Let us know in the comments![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #71 "Look at those moves!"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]As we continue on our way to make sure that the game looks good and has its own style we're also working on animating our courier![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/f170c24f6bf4cd2e508ebd91c1e662e5744d63d8.gif[/img]

We're starting off with a simple walking animation that will be your bread and butter when playing the game. We know, we know - everyone likes to abuse the run button however sometimes it's way better to simply walk the distance instead of running it! Look at our courier and his dignified walking style. Definitely something to be admired! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/90877c7cd9d36540c4bbab342a7fe8ceb6ebfa6b.gif[/img]

Running, obviously also available in game, will carry the necessary weight to it. You can almost hear the sound of our courier's boots on the ground. He is determined to run to his destination and deliver the final package of the day. He can do it - look at his gritted teeth, full of passion for his job and not at all irritated that he has to do it once again today... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/5a4bb8293bb862bebae6098f357470b4a4e7a059.gif[/img]

Think about it - how often do you jump in real life with a purpose to it? That's an interesting question, right? anyway, our courier might sometimes have to jump in order to traverse a difficult terrain. In this case we wanted to encapsulate his whole being and make the animation as realistic as possible. You be the judge - what do you think about this animation?

[i]Thank you very much for tuning in this week! Cheers![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #70 "Control yourself!"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]We are aware that many of you have you favorite way to play games – be it gamepad or keyboard and mouse.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/9e5cfd6e9d348841d038e2f2194635949a3ad754.png[/img]

We believe that all of you should be free to choose your preferred way of gaming! That is why we plan for the game to be able to handle both ways of controlling your main character and his trusty truck. As you might notice there is a lot of various functions that you can use in-game meaning that a lot of buttons will have to be pressed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/e349497a235d95cfbf08f3ff9b146d8d159cb07c.jpg[/img]

While there are many options and many keyboard shortcuts to facilitate the gameplay we are preparing for you, we will also make sure to not forget about the gamepad players and make sure to develop the game in a way that would allow for more than comfortable gameplay with a pad in your hands. Currently we have prepared the button scheme visible below but we might still revisit it and change the buttons depending on the internal testing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/724882fb8c73c1a137da970b34669adb2671eadd.jpg[/img]

Bear in mind that those screenshots are still Work in Progress and as such they can be change - including the functions the buttons serve! 

[i]Let us know what kind of player you are – do you prefer pad or K&B combination?[/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #69 "Truck Revolution!"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]Not so long ago we've had the pleasure to show you our refreshed courier... but wait, there's more![/h2]

You know how it is - a knight can be skilled and dedicated to his job but it's their trusty stead that will bring them to their destination. As that is the case we know that we cannot simply improve one element of this combo without the other. A knight's armour received some polish, let's do the same for his mount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/b5e283813d4cebc12f9a4d6341830bbbe69dc83b.png[/img]

Our truck has never looked better, I'd say! Look at the mighty logo it display on its side, look at the tires and lights! The visualization of the truck you can see above and below is the greatest showcase of what we intend to do with the ride. We want it to feel safe but at the same deserving proper respect and invoking in you the feeling of riding in a classy drive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/00460ba15b56d8709e48415cca756b2b7d6921f0.png[/img]

It will be safer, it will be faster and it will be more reliable than our old truck, we're completely sure of it. But we are also very interested in your opinion! How do you like our renewed truck and the visualization we've prepared for it? We're all ears (or, in this case, eyes)! 

[i]Thank you for checking in with us this week and see you next time![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #66 "Courier Transformation!"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]Sometimes changes are necessary - they can be refreshing and make you feel ready for any challenge![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/fb5a2d8fce425e4df1f51ffa47c845aa772da24b.png[/img]

Above you can see our courier as we had seen him in many adventures up until this point. With so many deliveries and so many missions under his belt even he can feel a little bit tired! In order to give him some new strength and energy to face another day we offered him a chance to change his looks a little bit and we're happy to say that he agreed! And as such we started planning his big reveal! Below you'll see the work we've done up until this moment - we're happy to say that he instantly became full of energy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/ca2ed4838a0d2eb0681e5262e817f65b1aee4279.png[/img]

New clothes can make a world of difference! As summer is coming we decided on more casual and lighter clothes - he is now ready to face all deliveries no matter the heat! We also spent some time on working on his physique so he might seem a little bit different to you! His face was also changed - he feels more approachable now which might be essential in his line of work. Maybe it's us but he also seems happier - and that's very important! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/9fe8785deac170518133fbfd896de11a417fd85f.png[/img]

Clothes might change but we needed to make sure that people will know that he is in fact a courier - the logo is still displayed on the back of his shirt to make sure that he can be recognized even from a far or if he is walking back to his van after a succesful delivery. Afterall not all heroes wear capes but this hero has his own way of showing off his status! 

[i]How do you like our new model for a courier? Let us know in the comments![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #60 "New UI elements"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]In some of the screenshots we've posted previously you might have seen some of these but we have implemented new UI elements in the game![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/41ba5a3bfc75d6daa240dc9b12c9ba6c2007bc26.png[/img]

Whenever you feel lost within the game and cannot find your garage the only thing you need to look for is a storage icon, as presented on the screenshot above. Thanks to it you'll always have the way to find where you should be going next in order to start a new courier mission. Your garage is almost your home so you instinctively know where it is located! Isn't that neat? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/e937e5e7f652f0fb94b7a6c1acf165fb35783e01.png[/img]

What is more we have redesigned the minimap to look more aesthetically pleasing to the eye. It has a nice round shape with orange glow and it shows all of the important incons for your convenience sake. It will also show where you need to go acting almost like a compass of sorts - covering all your most important navigational needs! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/52a27bc145b8384f30dceb48bec653a943cf94d4.png[/img]

We've also prepared a special indicator for the boxes and parcels that are important for your current mission. This way you'll never mistake the packages and your customers will always leave you a 5 star rating for your work. A happy customer is a happy courier! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/616ea52e981e87f98d7b9dd8c96013a1b52295d3.png[/img]

Notice also that after you enter the car you will be able to check your speedometer - to make sure you're not driving to fast make a habit of checking it periodically. If you have picked up your package and put it in the storage of your truck the indicator will also change and it will now show you the place you're supposed to go to - making your delivery so much more smooth. 

[i]Thank you for checking with us this week - take care![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #56 "Graffiti is not dead!"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]Have you noticed in the last devlog that the city got a little addition? It's graffiti![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/95957a48a6e743dd9d16fa4b0c4962f6bbf66e90.png[/img]

There are many forms of art and graffiti is one of them! Very popular in the city - it can take many forms starting with simple tags and words painted on different kinds ending with very complex graphical designs! When you'll be traveling through different part of the city you will be able to spot many examples of them and perhaps you'll even have a chance to find some easter eggs or interesting art forms? Stay alert and look around! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/12fabb187df6215f5f62a47d032b81a603c5d879.png[/img]

What is your opinion about the graffiti? It is a topic that seems to have as many opponents as people in favour, treating graffiti as one of the highest form of art! Have you ever done a graffiti yourself or perhaps think about doing so? It is a time consuming process for the bigger ones and world is full of various examples of great works that are so memorable that they get world-wide renown! 

[i]Care to share examples of graffiti that you personally found likeable?[/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #50 "Take it or throw it!"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]One of the very important game mechanics that you will be able to use in the game is the ability to… creatively handle the packages. Or simply said - to throw stuff around![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/0cc19a518be73dbfb5297a74f7b71e19b0064732.png[/img]


[i]"But why would you even try to throw my packages around?"[/i] - you might ask. That’s a great question and quite honestly...  it’s not recommended to simply throw the products that your customers have ordered and are impatiently waiting for. However there are instances where throwing them might be the only option allowing you to do your job! And as we are the best courier around we leave no job unfinished! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/7ccde4adcb2aeb919d155848280bc8877f52823b.png[/img]


You will also have an option to pick other objects aside from the packages! Sometimes you will have to solve a short puzzle with that ability or clean the place that you are currently in. All for the sake of your customers. Hope they will pay you extra for that... It would be such a shame if our undertakings went unnoticed. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/1dcfe4b0cb51a5d361d05173794a4a5877b319d5.png[/img]


And even if they don’t pay you, at the very least you will have a clear conscience and you will know that you helped someone. Or perhaps even helped the whole planet by placing trash in an appropriate container? While you’re at that you can practice your throws - who knows maybe basketball career will become a second career option for you?


[i]Take it or throw it - decision is yours![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

[url=https://discord.gg/WWDM2Bx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #46 "Just park it over there!"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]Many of most likely know that annoying feeling when you’re trying to find a parking spot and suddenly all seem to be taken except this single one that is just so narrow…[/h2]

[b]Being a courier means being a driver. You and your truck are a combo that cannot be separated! You’re delivering packages together and you’re going through different hardships together, that’s a given. For example this place, let’s take a look at it![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/07d3ef6cc88c66d0863f8560456269e46a2b1859.jpg[/img] 

[b]But even though you should respect your truck sometimes having it will also mean having to go through certain problems. In this particular case the guy who told us to come for his stuff asked us to park in a very specific and narrow spot. Well, it’s not the worst place and you can expect many worse places to park in future but nonetheless – it’s easy to cause an accident so let’s be careful! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/18bc1904e62ab85c97dc199f2ee1206dd7407cb6.jpg[/img]
 
[b]That will not happen in real life, unfortunately, but in this case we have some technological help – the camera switches to one above us making it a little bit easier for us to park in the designated place. That’s nice, thank you camera man![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/9fcc66be6bbee358a7ad6e4b9894e288aa7515a6.jpg[/img] 

[b]And voila! It’s done! Well, actually it’s just the beginning, we just parked but it’s okay to feel a little happy even for the smallest achievements! Anyway, as you can imagine you will see many different challenges during your work as a courier so be mindful and careful![/b]
[i]Thankfully there’s no instructor to rate our parking skills but it won’t hurt to be extra careful![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

[url=https://discord.gg/WWDM2Bx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/904850/FatEX_Courier_Simulator/

notes.content:

Recently we were working on new missions! 🥳🎊

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator ~ Devlog #16 "Physics of carrying packages"
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, couriers !!![/b][/h1]

Recently, we've been working on a package physics system similar to [i]Death Stranding[/i]. 
We managed to create something similar for the needs of our courier, so you will now have to be careful when carrying more packages or stacking them on top of each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/8aff8d8a59cb3c22419390667c7fb791c6746e7b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/df093e4a6a4710917cb60f8906ba4ac83c6a03ef.png[/img]

Remember that each pack has its own durability. If the packages often fall down or we hit them with other items, their durability will also decrease, as well as the payment for our delivery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/67250e844a84aff3021bd0a517d1da03e1152dcb.png[/img]

[i][b]Do you like the new system introduced to the game?[/b][/i]

Best regards
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/904850/FatEX_Courier_Simulator/
